name: CMS Site Settings
description: Everything an editor can change site-wide: title, public URL, description, contact email, footer text, social links, and the navigation menu. The menu editor further down now holds four groups — Programs, Communities, Content Hub, Membership. Chapters is deliberately absent: it is generated from the chapters collection, so publishing a chapter puts it in the menu and there is nothing to hand-maintain here. The trade is that Chapters cannot be renamed or reordered from this screen.
